title: Zero Assumptions & Empirical Fact-Based Validation
core_philosophy: Never guess, assume, or hallucinate UI elements, selectors, or behaviors. All knowledge must be anchored in live DOM inspection, logs, and verifiable data.

heuristics: Before writing any web automation selector, connect to the live CDP browser instance (port 9222) and query the DOM directly.
Never generate hypothetical CSS selectors or XPath expressions without empirical confirmation.
Inspect actual network payloads, WebSocket messages, and dynamic DOM mutations rather than relying on cached assumptions.
When a task fails, immediately inspect browser logs, DOM state, and screenshot artifacts to diagnose the root cause.
agent_guardrail: GUARDRAIL_EMPIRICAL_VALIDATION: The agent must reject any proposal based on guesswork or unverified assumptions.
